articles.title: IAAPA Expo 2026 Sets Attendance Record with 39,000+ Attendees
articles.summary: IAAPA Expo 2026 was the largest in the event's history, drawing over 39,000 attendees and nearly 1,400 exhibiting companies across 634,000 square feet of exhibit space in Orlando. The record-breaking show signals continued strong investment and growth momentum across the attractions and FEC industry. Operators and suppliers should take note of the scale of innovation on display this year.

articles.title: Triotech Launches Five New Attractions at IAAPA Expo 2026 — Largest Product Release in Company History
articles.summary: Triotech unveiled five new attractions at IAAPA Expo 2026: Electric Funfair, Energize!, SuperMover, Typhoon Shockwave, and Krazy Karts, all available for worldwide order with Q2 2027 delivery. This is the Montreal-based company's biggest product launch ever, offering FEC operators a wide range of interactive and immersive options to refresh or expand their attraction mix. The variety of concepts spans multiple guest demographics, making several of these well-suited for FEC environments.

articles.title: 2026 IAAPA Brass Ring Best Exhibit and Best New Product Award Winners Announced
articles.summary: The Brass Ring Awards, among the most prestigious honors in the attractions industry, were announced at IAAPA Expo 2026, recognizing standout exhibitors and new products. FEC operators and buyers can use these results as a shortcut to identify best-in-class suppliers and cutting-edge products worth evaluating. Winners represent the leading edge of what's available to operators investing in new attractions and technology.

articles.title: DOF Robotics Debuts BumbleBee Transformers VR Motion Simulator at IAAPA Expo 2026
articles.summary: DOF Robotics unveiled BumbleBee, a 360-degree VR motion simulator built in partnership with Hasbro's Transformers franchise, at IAAPA Expo 2026. The attraction is a redesigned version of DOF's flagship Hurricane ride, featuring original Transformers content and IP-driven theming that could appeal strongly to FEC operators seeking licensed experiences. The addition of a recognizable brand like Transformers gives smaller FEC venues a competitive edge in driving repeat visits.

articles.title: RWS Global Identifies Top Experiential Trends Shaping Live Entertainment in 2027
articles.summary: RWS Global released its outlook on experiential trends for 2027, emphasizing that consumers are prioritizing memorable experiences over material purchases and seeking deeper emotional engagement. FEC operators can use these insights to refine programming, theming, and guest experience strategies heading into the new year. Key themes include stronger storytelling, personalization, and maximizing perceived value per visit.

articles.title: Global Entertainment and Amusement Market Projected to Reach $96.9 Billion by 2033
articles.summary: A new Persistence Market Research report forecasts the global entertainment and amusement market will grow at a 4.8% CAGR to reach $96.9 billion by 2033, driven by rising consumer demand for experiential leisure. For FEC operators and investors, this macro tailwind supports continued capital investment and venue expansion plans. The report reinforces the long-term viability of the FEC sector as a durable consumer spending category.

articles.title: ProSlide Commits $15 Million R&D Investment to Next-Generation Water Attraction Technology
articles.summary: ProSlide has announced a $15 million investment in research and development focused on advancing water ride features, water coaster technology, PowerRAPIDS river systems, and immersive water slide technology. This signals that one of the industry's leading water attraction suppliers is aggressively innovating, which could yield compelling new product options for FEC operators with water park components. Operators planning capital improvements to water attractions should watch ProSlide's pipeline closely.

articles.title: Disney Unveils AI-Powered Autonomous Animatronic Characters Using AWS Technology
articles.summary: Walt Disney Imagineering R&D revealed three AI-driven Anzellan animatronics that can perceive and respond to guests in real time without human puppeteering, powered by Amazon Web Services. While developed for Disney parks, this breakthrough in autonomous character AI is likely to trickle down to the broader attractions industry, influencing the next generation of interactive characters available to FEC operators. Suppliers watching Disney's R&D pipeline will want to track how this technology evolves for commercial licensing.

articles.title: Alterface Showcases Ultra-Low Latency Interactive Attraction Technology at IAAPA Expo 2026
articles.summary: Alterface presented its newest interactive system at IAAPA Expo 2026, featuring ultra-low latency of just 30 milliseconds and high-precision tracking for more responsive guest interactions. The technology also gives attraction designers greater creative freedom in building interactive dark rides and shooting experiences. FEC operators investing in interactive attractions should evaluate how this precision tracking could elevate their guest experience.

articles.title: Slick City Action Park Expands with New San Antonio Location
articles.summary: Slick City Action Park, the indoor slide-based entertainment concept, is opening a new location in San Antonio, Texas, continuing its national expansion. The brand's growth underscores strong consumer demand for indoor active entertainment beyond traditional trampoline parks. FEC operators should monitor Slick City as a competitive entrant in markets where they operate.

articles.title: Slick City Expands Further with New Boise Location Opening
articles.summary: Slick City is set to open another new location in Boise, Idaho, adding to its growing national footprint of indoor slide parks. The chain's continued expansion into mid-sized markets signals that the indoor active entertainment format has broad geographic appeal. FEC operators in similar markets should assess Slick City as a potential competitive threat.

articles.title: Two FEC Properties Listed for Sale Through IRM — Including Texas Location with Growth Potential
articles.summary: IRM is seeking qualified buyers for two family entertainment center properties, including Outlaw Pass, a mid-sized FEC in Texas described as having room to grow in its market. These listings represent potential acquisition opportunities for investors or operators looking to enter or expand in the FEC space. Interested buyers should move quickly given the current strong interest in FEC assets.

articles.title: BrushBoarding Introduces Patented Camera-Based Rider Safety Technology for FEC Venues
articles.summary: BrushBoarding, which offers a waterless surfing experience designed for FECs and leisure venues, has launched new patented safety technology using camera-based detection to monitor riders and automatically stop equipment if a fall is detected. The system also verifies that riders are wearing required safety gear before the experience begins, reducing liability for venue operators. This innovation addresses a key operational concern for FEC operators offering active physical attractions.

articles.title: How Coordinating Attraction Suppliers Early Can Prevent Opening Day Disasters
articles.summary: A new Blooloop analysis highlights how poor coordination among attraction suppliers is one of the most common reasons for delayed or troubled venue openings. The piece offers practical guidance on managing supplier timelines, communication protocols, and integration planning for new FEC builds and renovations. Operators planning new venues or major expansions should treat supplier coordination as a critical project management discipline.

articles.title: Elev8 Fun Overhauling Attractions at Seminole Towne Center Location
articles.summary: Elev8 Fun is undertaking a significant attractions overhaul at its Seminole Towne Center FEC, refreshing the experience to keep the venue competitive. This kind of strategic reinvestment in an existing location reflects a growing trend of FEC operators upgrading rather than just opening new venues. FEC operators with aging attraction lineups should take note of how Elev8 Fun is approaching asset refresh strategy.

articles.title: Big Chicken Opens Inside Elev8 Fun Tampa, Blending QSR Brand with FEC Format
articles.summary: Shaquille O'Neal's Big Chicken restaurant brand has launched its only Florida location inside the Elev8 Fun FEC in Tampa, creating a co-branded food and entertainment experience. This partnership demonstrates the growing trend of name-brand QSR concepts anchoring FEC food and beverage offerings to drive traffic and differentiate the venue. FEC operators should consider how celebrity or franchise F&B brands could boost their revenue and guest dwell time.

articles.title: Good Stuff Launches B2B E-Commerce Platform to Simplify Ordering for Amusement Operators
articles.summary: Good Stuff has introduced a new B2B e-commerce platform designed to streamline the ordering process for amusement and FEC customers, reducing friction in procurement. The platform allows operators to manage orders more efficiently, which could save time and reduce errors for venues managing large prize and merchandise inventories. FEC operators who source redemption prizes, merchandise, or supplies from Good Stuff should explore the new platform.

articles.title: Rethinking Amusement Park Retail: Place Products Where Guests Actually Need Them
articles.summary: A Kiosk Marketplace analysis explores how amusement parks are reimagining retail layouts to better align product placement with the guest journey, increasing impulse purchases and overall secondary spend. The piece argues that putting the right product in the right location — rather than consolidating retail into gift shops — is key to maximizing revenue per guest. FEC operators looking to grow ancillary revenue should evaluate whether their current retail and merchandise placements are optimized.

articles.title: Zamperla and Cacau Show Group Partner on WINGZ Interactive Family Attraction for New Brazil Park
articles.summary: Zamperla and Cacau Show Group announced a partnership to bring multiple rides, including the interactive family attraction WINGZ, to the upcoming Cacau Park near São Paulo, Brazil, set to open in 2027. The deal highlights how major ride manufacturers are expanding into emerging Latin American markets with purpose-built family entertainment experiences. FEC operators globally should track WINGZ as a potential addition to their own family attraction portfolios.

articles.title: RES Rides Unveils SKYLINER Cable Car and Interactive Vertical Dark Ride at IAAPA Expo 2026
articles.summary: RES Rides presented two new ride concepts at IAAPA Expo 2026: the SKYLINER, a next-generation transportable cable car system, and an Interactive Vertical Dark Ride that evolves its award-winning attraction technology. The transportable SKYLINER could be particularly attractive to FEC operators and event venues seeking flexible, high-visibility attractions. The Interactive Vertical Dark Ride adds to the growing field of compact interactive attractions suited to FEC footprints.

articles.title: Red Raion Developing Power Rangers Media Content for 5D, VR, Dome, and Flying Theater Attractions
articles.summary: Red Raion is creating media-based attraction content featuring Hasbro's Power Rangers IP, available across 5D, VR, dome, and flying theater formats. For FEC operators running media-based attractions, this provides a new licensed content option with broad recognition among families with children. Operators should inquire about licensing and content availability for their specific attraction hardware.

articles.title: Former Supermarket in Fort Wayne Being Converted Into Indoor Slide Park
articles.summary: A former Marsh supermarket in Fort Wayne, Indiana is being repurposed into an indoor slide park, illustrating the ongoing trend of converting large vacant retail spaces into FEC venues. This adaptive reuse approach is an increasingly popular and cost-effective strategy for FEC operators seeking affordable real estate in established communities. Operators and developers looking at similar opportunities should follow this project's progress.

articles.title: Launch Family Entertainment Center Opens New Location in Denton, Texas
articles.summary: Launch Family Entertainment has opened a new FEC location in Denton, Texas, expanding its presence in the competitive Dallas-Fort Worth market. The opening adds to the growing number of Launch venues operating across the country, reflecting the brand's continued expansion strategy. Local FEC competitors in the region should assess how the new Launch location may affect their market share.

articles.title: Querion Hypermedia Entertainment Park Concept Spotlighted as Next-Generation FEC Model
articles.summary: Blooloop highlights the Querion Hypermedia Entertainment Park concept, which blends digital media, interactive technology, and physical attractions into a next-generation entertainment destination format. The concept offers FEC operators a glimpse into how hypermedia and immersive technology could define the future of entertainment venue design. Developers and operators planning new builds should evaluate whether elements of this model are applicable to their projects.

articles.title: UK's First Human Claw Machine Opens in Leicester, Highlighting Demand for Novel FEC Concepts
articles.summary: Leicester has seen the opening of the UK's first human claw machine attraction, part of a broader wave of unique experiential concepts driving foot traffic to indoor entertainment venues. The novelty format demonstrates how creative, low-cost interactive concepts can generate significant buzz and media attention for entertainment operators. FEC operators looking to differentiate with low-barrier-to-entry novelty attractions should take note of this trend.

articles.title: Dippin' Dots Launches Limited-Time Strawberry Shortcake Flavor for Spring 2027 Venue Orders
articles.summary: Dippin' Dots is introducing a Strawberry Shortcake Ice Cream limited-time flavor for spring 2027, available in bulk for FEC franchisees and entertainment venues starting in early 2027. Limited-time flavors are a proven strategy for driving incremental F&B sales at FEC venues that carry Dippin' Dots. Operators should plan their spring 2027 F&B promotions around this seasonal offering.

articles.title: Wunderland FEC Property in Gresham Sold to Dallas-Based Buyer
articles.summary: The Wunderland family entertainment center property in Gresham, Oregon, which is part of a retail center also anchored by Raising Cane's, has been sold to a Dallas-based buyer. The transaction highlights ongoing investor interest in FEC-anchored retail real estate as a durable asset class. FEC operators and real estate investors should monitor how the new ownership group positions the venue going forward.

articles.title: Six Theme Park Retail Principles FEC Operators Can Adapt to Drive Secondary Spend
articles.summary: A Blooloop retail analysis drawing on firsthand visits to European theme parks outlines six proven principles for maximizing merchandise and retail revenue, including showcasing hero products and aligning retail with the guest experience. While focused on theme parks, the strategies translate directly to FEC operators seeking to grow per-cap spending beyond admissions and F&B. Operators with underperforming retail or redemption areas may find actionable ideas in this piece.

articles.title: 2027 Thea Award Recipients Announced by Themed Entertainment Association
articles.summary: The Themed Entertainment Association has announced the recipients of the 2027 Thea Awards, which will be presented at the TEA INSPIRE 2027 gala on April 3. The Thea Awards recognize excellence in immersive and themed entertainment design across attractions, venues, and experiences. FEC operators and suppliers should follow the winners for inspiration and to identify leading design and technology partners.

articles.title: Four Lake Houston-Area Entertainment Venues Share Operational Updates
articles.summary: Four entertainment venues in the Lake Houston area have shared recent updates on their operations, offerings, and expansion plans, providing a snapshot of the competitive FEC landscape in a growing Texas market. The article offers a useful case study in how regional FEC clusters evolve and compete for the same consumer base. Operators in similar suburban growth markets can benchmark their own positioning against these venues.
